name: Cloudflare Queues Free
free_limit: Cloudflare Queues on Workers Free: 10,000 standard operations/day, 24-hour non-configurable message retention
watch_out: A message delivery normally consumes 3 operations (write, read, delete), with additional reads for retries and extra operations for payloads over 64 KB. Queue operations are not a 10,000-messages/day guarantee; Workers Free usage has separate limits. Message retention is fixed to 24 hours on Free, unlike configurable Paid.
